PROP-01b-partial3-inv-049.text: Pyth oracle adaptor must validate price confidence and reject stale or low-confidence prices.
PROP-01b-partial3-inv-049.assertion: forall pyth_price p: p.expo normalized AND p.conf/p.price <= threshold AND p.publish_time fresh

locations.note: Validates: (1) positive magnitude for price, (2) confidence within tolerance via assert_price_conf_within_range, (3) staleness via assert_price_not_stale, (4) decimal fits in u8
Normalizes Pyth exponent to protocol decimal format; asserts normalized value > 0
